csv_scope_of_work: The City of Crestwood, Missouri (herein after City or Owner ) invites qualified firms to submit their qualifications for on-all architectural design and construction management services. To work with the City s leadership as an essential member of a project development team. The services provided will include, but are not limited to, the following: 1. Site review. 2. Feasibility studies and conceptual work. 3. Conceptual estimates for budgeting purposes. 4. Finalized design drawings. 5. Full project manual and specifications 6. Gathering any/all necessary federal, state, and local permitting and approvals for projects. 7. Attend pre-bid meetings. 8. Assist City with bid management and provide construction management services

title: On-Call Crestwood Architectural Services
short_description: On-call architectural and construction management services for various City of Crestwood projects.
project_scope: On-call general building services for the City of Crestwood with undefined individual projects. Scope may include site reviews, feasibility studies, conceptual design, budgeting estimates, final design drawings, project manuals and specifications, permitting and approvals, pre-bid meeting attendance, bid management support, and construction management services. Disciplines requested include architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, construction/project management, and feasibility studies. Contract base period is 36 months with a 24-month renewal option.
services: On-call architectural design services, feasibility studies, conceptual work, budgeting estimates, final design drawings, specifications, permitting support, bid-phase assistance, and construction management.
relevance_explanation:

- Target market is general building, with no specific complex structure, bridge, roof, or special engineering scope.
- Includes broad architectural and project management services rather than focused structural engineering.
- Explicitly low relevance for sbp because framework agreements without technical specification are not desired.
